desc: Precompute q[p] = smallest index with A[q] >= 2*A[p] (else N), and D[p] = q[p] - p via two-pointer sweep.
Build a sparse table over D for O(1) range maximum queries.
For each query (L,R) with S=R-L+1, binary search largest K in [0,S//2] with maxD(L,L+K-1)+K <= S; output K.
Fast I/O; verified against Sample 1 (2,3,1,0,5) and Sample 2 outputs, plus edge cases (all equal, small intervals).
